{{Quote|What sort of species gets violent after eating Corellian apples?|Vitkins|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Vitkins''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] belonging to the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] unit loyal to the corrupt [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he and his partner, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Dobi]], were stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]] and were called in to a small dwelling to investigate reports of domestic disturbance. The two Pop-Dogs then found themselves caught in a trap set up by the [[Quad-Linked Militant Pacifists]], a fictitious terrorist organization that served as a front for [[Wraith Squadron]], a Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit investigating Thaal, and Vitkins and Dobi were then tied up. They were later discovered and freed by some of their fellow soldiers who followed up on their investigation.<ref name="MK" />
